वेङ्कट वेङ्कट, N. of a mountain; of the
son of Raghu-nātha-dīkṣita (author of the Viśva-
guṇādarśa); of a king of Vijaya-nagara; of the
author of the Śabdārtha-kalpa-taru lexicon, (his
father's name was also Veṅkaṭa.)
—वेङ्कट-गिरि,
इस्, m. the mountain Veṅkaṭa.
—वेङ्कट-नाथ,
[]
अस्, m., N. of an author.
—वेङ्कटाचलेश (˚ट-अच्˚,
˚ल-ईश), अस्, m. ‘lord of the Veṅkaṭa mountain,’
epithet of a deity.
